summary: Full review: round-5 advisories SEC-1..SEC-7 are resolved by beaf1b3c (--answer-file at every answer call site, one run lock across the record check, state write and record creation, a dirty tracked record refused, question fields validated and rendered before the write, the relay path confined to spec_dir, --design-fix shape-checked); one low partial-failure gap remains in record creation.

findings.summary: The relay record is created after the state write, and an OSError from mkdir or open('x') is not converted to exit 1, so the state holds the answer, no record exists and the command dies with a traceback.
findings.evidence: ENG-17 / ENG-26. answer_locked calls state.write_state(...) and then record_path.parent.mkdir(...) and record_path.open('x') with no except clause. cli.main catches only CLIError (cli.py:603). Reproduced: a dangling symlink at the record path pointing inside spec_dir gives exists() False, passes the resolve().is_relative_to(spec_root) check, and open('x') raises FileExistsError after the state write. Each retry hits the same path. Exposure is limited because the repository belongs to the user, so this is not blocking.
findings.fix: Refuse a record path that is a symlink (record_path.is_symlink()) before the write. Either create the record before the state write and remove it if write_state raises, or wrap the mkdir and open in an except OSError that converts to die(1, ...) and names the record so the inconsistency is reported.
